title: nf-core/msproteomics pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet CSV file

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

spectra.errorMessage: Mass spectrometry data must be a .raw, .mzML, .mzXML, .mgf, .mzBIN or .dia file or a Bruker .d directory, optionally compressed (.gz, .tar, .tar.gz, .zip)

condition.errorMessage: Condition must be a string; it only fills the TMT annotation / MSstats condition fields and does not drive grouping

fraction.errorMessage: Fraction identifier must be a positive integer

experiment.description: FragPipe experiment (InputLcmsFile.experiment). Files are grouped by experiment_bioreplicate, or by experiment when bioreplicate is blank. Blank experiment and bioreplicate put every file in one group.
experiment.errorMessage: Experiment must be a string (FragPipe replaces characters other than A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and _ with _)

bioreplicate.description: FragPipe bioreplicate (InputLcmsFile.replicate, an Integer). When set, the group is <experiment>_<bioreplicate>, or exp_<bioreplicate> when experiment is blank.

data_type.description: FragPipe data type of the LC-MS file (4th column of a FragPipe manifest, InputLcmsFile.dataType). When blank, FragPipe's InputLcmsFile.guessDataType() rule picks DDA, DIA or DDA+ from the file path.
data_type.errorMessage: data_type must be one of FragPipe's data types: DDA, DDA+, DIA, DIA-Quant, DIA-Lib, GPF-DIA
